description: This file defines the kaitenrestInterface class, which extends issueTrackerInterface, providing methods to connect to Kaiten bug tracking system, manage issues, and parse issue info. It includes configuration handling, connection setup, issue retrieval, creation, and commenting functionalities.

classes.name: kaitenrestInterface
classes.description: A class to interface with Kaiten bug tracking system, providing methods for connection, issue management, and configuration.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the kaitenrestInterface object, sets configuration, and establishes connection.

methods.name: completeCfg
methods.description: Completes configuration parameters, trims URLs, and sets options.

methods.name: checkBugIDSyntax
methods.description: Checks if the bug ID has a valid syntax.

methods.name: connect
methods.description: Establishes connection to Kaiten system and verifies connectivity.

methods.name: buildViewBugURL
methods.description: Builds URL to view a specific bug.

methods.name: getIssueStatusCode
methods.description: Returns the status code of an issue.

methods.name: getIssueStatusVerbose
methods.description: Returns the verbose status of an issue.

methods.name: getIssueSummaryHTMLString
methods.description: Returns the HTML string of issue summary.

methods.name: checkBugIDExistence
methods.description: Checks if a bug ID exists in Kaiten.

methods.name: parseAddInfo
methods.description: Parses additional info string into description and links.

methods.name: addIssue
methods.description: Creates a new issue in Kaiten with optional links and tags.

methods.name: addNote
methods.description: Adds a note/comment to an existing issue.

methods.name: getCfgTemplate
methods.description: Provides a template for configuration XML.

methods.name: canCreateViaAPI
methods.description: Indicates if issues can be created via API (returns true).
